meta.title: DoA Threshold Currency (approval.doa.currency) = EUR
gaps: Independently verify that EUR affects approval routing thresholds for every supported entity type and all existing DoA rules across the tenant.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Independently verify that EUR affects approval routing thresholds for every supported entity type and all existing DoA rules across the tenant.

steps.note: Set the tenant's DoA threshold currency to EUR before inspecting approval configuration.

args.goal: As the Tenant Admin, open Modular Approval Setup, configure an approval that can attach to an entity, and inspect the Delegation of Authority matrix so the spend-threshold definitions show EUR rather than the default INR; stop on the matrix showing the EUR currency.

steps.note: No catalog domain step reaches or configures Modular Approval Setup, so use the on-screen workflow to observe the controlled behavior.
Assert that the visible DoA threshold definitions use EUR.
